lines.zh: 步履沉重，甲片摩擦声响起。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps, metal clashing.

lines.zh: 挥舞着双刃，发出低沉的嘶吼。
lines.en: Swinging dual blades, low growl.

lines.zh: 移动时甲片互相碰撞，声音清脆。
lines.en: Metal clinks together as it moves.

lines.zh: 缓慢踱步，警惕地观察四周。
lines.en: Slowly pacing, cautiously looking around.

lines.zh: 步伐坚定，全身肌肉紧绷。
lines.en: Solid steps, muscles taut.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的威胁音，警告入侵者。
lines.en: Low, threatening rumble, warning intruders.

lines.zh: 走过时，地面上留下深深的划痕。
lines.en: Deep marks left on the ground as it passes.

lines.zh: 缓慢而沉重地行进，仿佛承载着什么。
lines.en: Slow, heavy strides, as if burdened.

lines.zh: 甲片间的摩擦声如同野兽的低语。
lines.en: Metallic scraping like a beast's whisper.

lines.zh: 步伐不稳，仿佛疲惫不堪。
lines.en: Unsteady steps, as if exhausted.

lines.zh: 空甲里晃着看不见的躯干。
lines.en: An unseen torso sways inside the empty armor.

lines.zh: 盾沿拖过石地，火星点点。
lines.en: My shield edge drags sparks across the stone.

lines.zh: 身体微微颤动，似乎在积蓄力量。
lines.en: Body trembling, power building.

lines.zh: 双手交叉，目光阴沉地盯着前方。
lines.en: Hands crossed, glaring ahead.

lines.zh: 慢慢转动着甲壳，寻找潜在威胁。
lines.en: Slowly rotating, searching for threats.

lines.zh: 半睁着眼睛，警觉地打量四周。
lines.en: Half-closed eyes, vigilantly surveying.

lines.zh: 身体微微前倾，随时准备战斗。
lines.en: Body slightly forward, ready to fight.

lines.zh: 双刃交叉置于胸前，保持警惕。
lines.en: Dual blades crossed, vigilant.

lines.zh: 缓慢呼吸，等待猎物靠近。
lines.en: Slow breathing, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 目光警惕，随时准备发起攻击。
lines.en: Wary gaze, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 身体轻轻摇晃，似乎在思考。
lines.en: Body swaying slightly, contemplating.

lines.zh: 双手紧握双刃，随时准备出手。
lines.en: Hands gripping blades, ready to strike.
Black mist seeps between my armor plates.

lines.zh: 我把盾立在身前，一动不动。
lines.en: I set my shield before me and hold still.

lines.zh: 盔甲深处传来低沉的祷告。
lines.en: A low prayer murmurs deep in my armor.
No breath, only iron creaking.

lines.zh: 眼中光芒一闪，锁定目标。
lines.en: Glimmer in eyes, locking target.

lines.zh: 双刃迅速抬起，准备攻击。
lines.en: Blades raised, ready to attack.
Shell turning, targeting player.

lines.zh: 目光锐利，盯着玩家不放。
lines.en: Sharp gaze, staring at player.

lines.zh: 身体猛然一动，向玩家逼近。
lines.en: Body lurching forward, closing in.

lines.zh: 双刃如闪电般挥动，试图击中玩家。
lines.en: Blades flashing, aiming to hit player.

lines.zh: 目光闪烁，寻找最佳攻击角度。
lines.en: Eyes flickering, seeking best angle.

lines.zh: 突然加速，向玩家发起突袭。
lines.en: Sudden acceleration, charging.

lines.zh: 目光锁定，准备致命一击。
lines.en: Target locked, preparing strike.

lines.zh: 双刃低垂，准备随时出击。
lines.en: Blades lowered, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 面甲后没有眼睛，只有光。
lines.en: No eyes behind my visor, only light.
I raise my shield and it mirrors your face.
My plates turn toward you one by one.

lines.zh: 我听见你心跳撞着肋骨。
lines.en: I hear your heart knocking at your ribs.

lines.zh: 你身上没有誓约的印记。
lines.en: You bear no mark of any oath.
My shield's light falls at your feet.
I am weighing how heavy you are.

lines.zh: 别动，让我看清你的盔甲。
lines.en: Hold still. Let me study your armor.
Aegis tears, blood seeps out.
Shield broken, pain unbearable.
Rust spreads, wounds worsen.
Wounds rot, poison spreads.
Severe pain, can't stand.
Wounds abundant, weak breath.
Aegis shattered, severe wounds.
Corrosion spreads, wounds worsen.

lines.zh: 盾上裂了一道口，我还在。
lines.en: A crack runs across my shield; I still stand.
A plate breaks loose and spite leaks out.

lines.zh: 盾光闪烁，引你深入黑暗。
lines.en: Shield light glimmers, luring you into the darkness.

lines.zh: 圣盾之光，引你走向死亡。
lines.en: The light of the sacred shield guides you to your doom.

lines.zh: 战裔圣盾，引你堕入绝境。
lines.en: Warborn Aegis leads you to the brink of extinction.
You are tempted by the shield's light.
In the darkness, the sacred shield calls to you.

lines.zh: 被圣盾的光芒吸引，你难以自拔。
lines.en: You cannot resist the shield's light.

lines.zh: 圣盾发出微弱的诱捕之光。
lines.en: The sacred shield emits a faint lure.

lines.zh: 你被圣盾的光芒深深吸引。
lines.en: You are deeply drawn to the shield's light.

lines.zh: 圣盾的光芒如魅影般诱惑。
lines.en: The shield's light tempts like a phantom.

lines.zh: 你无法抗拒圣盾的光芒。
lines.en: You cannot resist the shield's light.

lines.zh: 盾墙撞击，粉碎你的希望。
lines.en: Shield wall crashes, shattering your hope.

lines.zh: 圣盾的碰撞，粉碎你的梦想。
lines.en: The sacred shield's collision crushes your dreams.

lines.zh: 战裔圣盾，你的希望破灭。
lines.en: Warborn Aegis, your hope is shattered.
The collision tears through your defenses.

lines.zh: 圣盾的撞击，粉碎一切幻想。
lines.en: The sacred shield's impact shatters all illusions.

lines.zh: 你与圣盾的碰撞，徒劳无功。
lines.en: Your collision with the sacred shield is futile.
You are repelled by the shield's collision.
The sacred shield's collision pushes you back.

lines.zh: 你无法躲过圣盾的碰撞。
lines.en: You cannot evade the shield's collision.

lines.zh: 圣盾的碰撞，粉碎你的努力。
lines.en: The sacred shield's collision crushes your efforts.

lines.zh: 寻找圣盾的伴侣，困难重重。
lines.en: Finding a mate for the sacred shield is difficult.

lines.zh: 战裔圣盾，孤独的守护者。
lines.en: Warborn Aegis, the lonely guardian.
The sacred shield yearns for a mate.

lines.zh: 寻找伴侣，圣盾孤独前行。
lines.en: Finding a mate, the sacred shield walks alone.

lines.zh: 圣盾的伴侣，罕见而强大。
lines.en: The mate of the sacred shield is rare and powerful.
The sacred shield searches for a mate alone.
The sacred shield's loneliness is not understood.
Finding a mate, the sacred shield's fate.
The sacred shield desires a companion.

lines.zh: 孤独的圣盾，寻找着伴侣。
lines.en: The lonely sacred shield searches for a mate.

lines.zh: 厚重的盾牌发出金属声
lines.en: Heavy shield clanks
Holy light erupts from eyes
Mail armor creaks
Rumbles, a threat
Shield glows dimly
Heavy footsteps approach
Holy shield emits loud alarm
Warborn Aegis trembles
Holy flame burns on shield
Low growl, full of rage
Acquired target
Holy light converges
I raise my shield and take one step forward.

lines.zh: 圣盾表面，映出你的影子。
lines.en: Your shadow shows on the face of my holy shield.
Preparing to capture
Shield flashes, locking target
Prey surrounded by holy light
My shield face rises and locks onto you.
Aiming at prey, without mercy

lines.zh: 圣盾光芒闪烁，锁定猎物
lines.en: Shields glow, locking target
By oath, you are marked.

lines.zh: 盾面浮出一张模糊的脸。
lines.en: A blurred face surfaces on my shield.
The spite inside my armor turns to you.

lines.zh: 无人侍奉的圣盾选中了你。
lines.en: This masterless shield has chosen you.
Warborn blood boils within the iron.

lines.zh: 你成了我需要击倒的敌人。
lines.en: You become the foe I must strike down.
Guiding holy power
Holy light dancing around target
Target targeted by holy light
Shield locked, no escape
Target locked by holy force

lines.zh: 圣盾引导力量攻击目标
lines.en: Shield directing force at target
Target drawn by holy force
Shields focusing light
Holy light guiding to target

lines.zh: 圣盾锁定，目标陷入绝境
lines.en: Shield locked, target in peril
My shield edge drops half an inch.

lines.zh: 甲片的缝隙全部对准你。
lines.en: Every seam in my armor points at you.
I take half a step and the ground dips.
Twin blades unfold behind my back.
Holy light narrows into a single line.

lines.zh: 我在你身侧留了一个空位。
lines.en: I leave a gap at your flank.

lines.zh: 你的盾牌挡不住这一下。
lines.en: Your shield will not stop this.
My iron boot grinds the gravel underfoot.
I hold breath I do not have.
Before the blow, I give a salute.
Swing the holy shield, battle roar!
Holy light flickers, sever foes!
Battle cries echo, fear no foe!
Shield splits the army!
Fury burning, charge into battle!
Blood-stained shield, fight until end!
War spirit surges, crush foes like mud!
Rage to cut down enemies, sworn revenge!
Holy sword falls, souls shatter!
Revenge blade, devour foes!
My shield rim shatters your knee!
An iron fist drives through your chest!
Twin blades fall from above!
Holy light bursts before your eyes!
I slam you into the stone wall!
An iron elbow snaps your collarbone!
The oath-blade cuts through your armor!

lines.zh: 盾击之后，紧跟一记斩击！
lines.en: A shield bash, then a slash behind it!
Darkness reveals ominous signs!
Shadows birth souls of the living!
Fear seeds grow secretly!
Shadows hold, holy enemies!
Evil spirits from darkness!
Wrath condenses, appears in world!
Vengeful spirits return!
Nether realm, holy foes!
Wandering vengeful spirits!

lines.zh: 盔甲自行立起，空无一人。
lines.en: The armor stands up on its own, empty.
The altar cracks and iron rises.
My oath unfinished, I cannot rest.
Black mist fills this suit of armor.
A dead man's vow wakes me.

lines.zh: 旧战场多了一个守夜人。
lines.en: The old battlefield gains another watchman.
The shield lands first; then I take shape.
I am the guard who was forgotten.
Amid rust, I rise again.
Burned by flames, wounds worsen.
Severely injured from fall, can't move.
Injured from drowning, can't breathe.
Injured by explosion, unbearable pain.
Arrows pierce, severe wounds.
Burned by magic, wounds painful.
My shield dented; there's nothing inside.
Lightning strikes, excruciating pain.
Fall into void, immense pain.
